_comment: Recommended Key Vault RBAC role assignments. Apply with: az role assignment create --role <id> --assignee <principal> --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>

roles.use_for: Read-only audit / inventory access. Assign to security tooling principals.
Manage secret values. Assign to deployment service principals (NOT to humans on a regular basis).
Read secret values at runtime. Assign to App Service / Function / VM managed identities.
Manage keys. Assign to encryption key administrators.
Use keys for encrypt/decrypt/sign/verify. Assign to workload identities that need crypto operations.

anti_patterns: Do NOT assign 'Key Vault Administrator' to deployment principals — too broad.
Do NOT use legacy Access Policies if migrating to a new vault — RBAC is the path forward.
Do NOT skip 'Key Vault Reader' for ops humans — they often need just to see what's there.
